title: ByeFrame

reason.description: Why the environment is closing the connection: the token is invalid, foreign or unknown; it expired; the client session was revoked; the protocol versions differ; or the environment is draining or updating.

protocolVersion.description: The environment's own protocol version, sent with reason protocol so the client can name both.

description: From the environment, before it closes the connection: why, so the client reconnects only when it should.
